description: Source code for a QUIC protocol server implementation, specifically the 'quic_simple_server.cc' file which manages server initialization, socket listening, packet reading, and processing for a QUIC server within the Chromium project.

classes.name: QuicSimpleServer
classes.description: A server class implementing a QUIC protocol server, managing socket creation, packet processing, and server lifecycle.

methods.name: QuicSimpleServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing server with configuration, proof source, supported versions, and backend.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets default flow control windows and adds default crypto config.

methods.name: CreateUDPSocketAndListen
methods.description: Creates UDP socket and starts listening on specified address.

methods.name: HandleEventsForever
methods.description: Runs the server event loop indefinitely.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Binds socket to address and initializes dispatcher and packet writer.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the server, closing socket and dispatcher.

methods.name: StartReading
methods.description: Begins asynchronous reading of incoming packets.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation, processing packets or handling errors.
